title: The Fox and the Boar
summary: A wild boar was diligently whetting his tusks against the trunk of a tree. A fox asked why he was sharpening his weapons when no hunter was near....
full_text:
A wild boar was diligently whetting his tusks against the trunk of a tree. A fox asked why he was sharpening his weapons when no hunter was near.

The boar answered: "When peril strikes, I will have no time to hone my tusks; I must have them ready for battle before the enemy arrives!"
moral: Prepare your weapons in times of peace, so you are ready when danger strikes.
